title: Hope gains a fair shared direction

captions.emotions: Focused pleasure in moving forward together

meaning: Hope for a meaningful continuation can inspire fair actions and pleasure in moving forward together.
text: An important prospect can unite you even while its result remains distant. The Star in the energy of Sahasrara supports hope and a wish to participate in a meaningful continuation. Justice in the physical position describes shared actions: aligning capacities with promises, stating conditions and considering consequences. The Chariot in emotions brings focused pleasure in progress. It feels rewarding that your participation has gained direction and helps people approach a shared endeavour without promises of miraculous results or demands to complete the whole journey immediately. Something important can have an accessible next step within conditions both of you actually understand.

For example, you help prepare a first public screening of an amateur film. Together, you clarify permission to show it, available room time and the number of places genuinely on offer. **An honest agreement turns hope into accessible movement.** A first viewer signs up and invites someone to discuss the film afterwards. Focused pleasure concerns your work allowing a story to reach people while distinguishing present promises from later possibilities.

It becomes harder if every promise invites comparison of who advanced the result faster. Discussion of fair contributions takes more time than the agreed action. Hope and pleasure in progress remain supportive. Actions benefit from distinguishing clear responsibility for a particular part from continual mutual accounting that prevents you using an agreement already reached.
